# has license

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasLicense>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

Relates an entity (a work, dataset, software project, …) to a licence granting rights in it ([dcterms:license](http://purl.org/dc/terms/license); [schema:license](https://schema.org/license)). Named [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md) — gmeow:license is reserved for the mapping-DSL set-license datatype property.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md)
